headline: Hydration is maintaining water levels—every cell needs water to function properly
universal_truth: The obvious things are often the most important; basic maintenance enables everything else
fun_facts: Even 2% dehydration impairs cognitive performance and physical capability
Your brain is about 75% water—hydration directly affects thinking
Thirst often indicates you're already mildly dehydrated—drink before you're thirsty
discussion_questions: How well do you maintain basic needs like hydration?
What obvious fundamentals do you neglect?
What happens to your performance when basics slip?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Water seems boring, basic, obvious. Yet every chemical reaction in your body requires it. Dehydrate even slightly, and thinking fogs, energy drops, performance suffers. The most basic things are often the most important.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: We chase complex solutions while neglecting simple fundamentals. What does hydration teach about basics?
cliff.prompt: Why do basics matter so much?

options.text: Basics enable everything else—without foundational needs met, sophisticated capabilities fail; the most impactful improvements are often the most boring
options.response: Yes. No amount of advanced technique compensates for dehydration. Fundamentals must be in place before fancy strategies matter. Boring basics are often the highest-leverage improvements.

options.text: Water is just essential for life
options.response: Essential, yes, but the broader principle is that fundamentals enable everything else...

q1.title: Foundation First
q1.script: Water is foundation—without it, nothing else works. You can't optimize what isn't fueled. Check basics before seeking advanced solutions. Often the answer is boring but essential.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Foundation First"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Invisible Deficits
q2.script: Mild dehydration often goes unnoticed. You feel 'off' without knowing why. Performance suffers from invisible causes. Check the obvious before diagnosing the obscure.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Maintenance Is Invisible
q3.script: Good hydration gets no credit—you just function. Only failure is noticed. This is true for all maintenance: sleep, nutrition, relationships. Invisible work enables visible performance.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: The obvious things are often the most important. Basic maintenance enables everything else. Don't neglect fundamentals.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 309. Tomorrow, we'll explore preparing your body—warm-up and stretching. Until then, drink some water.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Fundamentals Check - What Basics Are You Neglecting?
growTrack.activity: What basics do you neglect—sleep, water, nutrition, rest, connection? These are boring but essential. Which fundamental, if maintained, would most improve your performance? Focus there first.
